analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY in confirmed uptrend (+4.99% 20d slope) — conditions favor selective long exposure but not aggression.

EXISTING POSITIONS REVIEW: A (Agilent) is working — +8% vs SMA50, SMA50 slope accelerating at +6.2%, earnings 62 days out, thesis intact. Hold with current stop. LII is the strongest performer at +7.62% — momentum intact, hold. No thesis breaks detected in either name; no exits proposed.

PERFORMANCE CONTEXT: 33% win rate, 0.69 profit factor, and a -6.77 Sortino are serious red flags. Five consecutive stop-outs signal either bad luck clustering or entries that lack sufficient trend confirmation. This cycle I'm deliberately limiting to 2 high-conviction setups with wide ATR-based stops, avoiding earnings-in-<3-weeks names, and favoring value-with-momentum over pure momentum.

SCREENED SETUP RATIONALE: AMP offers exceptional value (fwd P/E 9.66, ROE 67%, op margin 37%) basing exactly at SMA50 in the lower third of its 52w range — a textbook Stage 1/2 transition with earnings 28 days out (watch risk). CDW is an IT infrastructure distributor with fwd P/E 11, ROE 44%, and accelerating analyst revisions (+3.6%) in a confirmed uptrend with earnings 41 days out — enough runway. Both names have genuine fundamental catalyst (earnings revision cycle) paired with technical basing setups. Cash remains dominant at ~70% pre-trade; after both adds it moves to roughly 28%, well within prudent risk limits.

WARNING: With a 0.69 profit factor, the system is net-negative. The correct posture is disciplined sizing and hard stops — not adding more risk. Both trades sized at 1-1.5% portfolio heat per name.
